# Bots, teams and agents (backup)

> 2026-11-10. Backup of Audrey's bots and teams so each can be called and re-created. All call names: **[CALL-NAMES.md](CALL-NAMES.md)**. Shared rules: [BOT-COMMON-RULES.md](BOT-COMMON-RULES.md). Machine-readable roster: [BOT-ROSTER.json](BOT-ROSTER.json).

## Layout

- `bots/bot-<name>/README.md`: every box bot. Call `/bot-<name>`.
- `teams/<team>-team/README.md`: every team. Call `/<team>-team`.
- `agents/<name>/README.md`: existing OpenRouter personas (`/coder`, `/oaudrey`, ...). No prefix, so you can tell agents from bots.
- Extends, does not replace, [agents/README.md](agents/README.md) (tool profiles) and the existing persona launcher.

## Counts

98 bots, 16 teams (including the existing `/dragnet-team`), 9 agents/personas.

## Privacy

This repo is public. Removed: emails, home and business locations, a business registration id, a family member's name and health details, account-recovery specifics, and two SenseCrew prompts (Sense-Quill, Sense-Chitin) that are kept in the private backup. No keys, tokens or memory contents.
